model: Global MG94xREV, CF3x4, fixed per-case nucleotide topology, shared omega, profile confidence interval
interpretation: Full eligible diagnostic queue, not a pilot. Starts cases as nucleotide-tree execution receipts become available. Full independent tree and codon output audits, convergence/alignment/copy/recombination/saturation review remain required before interpretation. Component branch lengths are synonymous/nonsynonymous substitutions per site, not automatically conventional dS/dN per synonymous/nonsynonymous site. No selection test. Runtime and memory are planning allowances, not measured bounds.
cost: Existing authorized local host; no new charges
